title: Two-Chord Practice: A and D Chords for Beginners (Dance The Night Away & More)
summary: JustinGuitar's beginner-focused tutorial demonstrates practicing with songs that use only two chords, A and D, to improve chord changes and rhythm. He explains that the early days will be challenging, advises selecting songs with minimal chord changes or slowing the tempo, and promotes using his Beginner Song Course app to tailor speed and accompaniment. The video spotlights the two-chord pattern in Dance The Night Away by The Mavericks (D for a bar, then A for a bar, repeated) and mentions additional two-chord options such as Born In The USA, You Sound Good To Me, and Silence Is Easy. It also covers anchor finger technique, counting and strumming on the beat, and the value of play-alongs—both in-app and on the website—for a more song-like practice experience. The message emphasizes persistence, a practical 10-minute practice window, and forgiving oneself during the early learning process.
